svg.title: Synthetic learning-rate schedule configuration controls
svg.desc: Original warmup1 ramps throughout100steps. Explicit one-step local candidate peaks at count1. An accepted endpoint120 beyond horizon100 yields a jump at count100. No actual Hero or training loss evidence.
